text:
Irene (Acme AP): Hi — our customer's AP just rejected the PDF we sent. They say the supplier/legal block is missing from the header, VAT number isn't visible, and the PO number isn't in the top-right where their system expects it. They attached a rejection screenshot. Can you advise?

Michelle (Support): Thanks Irene. Can you paste the AP rejection text or screenshot copy/paste? Do they require a strict field order (e.g., legal entity on left, PO top-right)? Any example from them would help. :eyes:

Irene (Acme AP): Sure — rejection note says: "Invoice rejected: missing supplier legal entity and VAT/Tax ID in header. Purchase Order number not present in header (expected top-right). Line items must include unit price and tax amount per line. PDF template appears to omit payer/payee legal block." They also flagged that the address block is condensed and some line items only show total.

Michelle (Support): Reproduced quickly with a sandbox invoice. Rendering looks like the supplier block collapsed when supplier.legal_entity is empty. Attaching a small snippet of the invoice payload that produced the blank header: ```json
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_9001",
  "supplier": {
    "name": "Acme Ltd"
    // note: no "legal_entity" or "vat_number" keys present in this payload
  },
  "po_number": null,
  "items": [{
    "description": "SaaS subscription",
    "amount": 1200
    // unit_price missing, tax missing
  }]
}```

InvoiceBot: PDF renderer v2.4.1 - render started for invoice inv_9001 at 1923456790, template=template_v3, renderer=wkhtmltopdf-0.12.6

Tony (Eng): Thanks for the repro and payload. Quick diagnosis: template_v3 expects supplier.legal_entity and supplier.vat_number keys to populate the legal block; if they are absent or null it collapses the whole block. Also the header layout expects `po_number` in metadata.header.po; when null it doesn't render the top-right box. Repro steps I ran locally: 1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/render-invoice -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_9001","supplier":{"name":"Acme Ltd"},"items":[{"description":"SaaS","amount":1200}]}' 2) open returned PDF -> header missing legal block.

Quick fix: update template mapping to fallback from `supplier.legal_entity` -> `supplier.name` and from `metadata.header.po` -> `po_number` (two-line mapping). But note: EU customers often require explicit VAT ID label formatting (e.g., "VAT ID: IE1234567A"). Sam, does Finance want the fallback or prefer failing loudly so we don't accidentally publish non-compliant invoices?

Sam (Finance): We need to be careful. For legal/regulatory EU invoices we must display the supplier legal entity and VAT ID when provided. But fallback to supplier.name is acceptable only if the VAT ID is empty *and* we mark the invoice as "VAT ID: not provided" in the PDF. Also line items must show unit price and tax. If the upstream billing system omits unit_price we should calculate unit_price = amount / quantity where quantity >1, otherwise flag for manual review. Can we add a small validation step before render that returns HTTP 422 with a clear error: `missing_fields: [supplier.legal_entity, supplier.vat_number, items.unit_price]`? That would stop bad PDFs from being sent to customers.

Tony (Eng): Yup, adding a pre-render validator is straightforward. Proposal: 1) Soft-fallback in template (supplier.name -> shown as "Supplier name (legal entity missing)") 2) Pre-render validation endpoint that returns 422 with a checklist. 3) Canary deploy mapping change to template_v3 with fallback on 10% of traffic for 24h. ETA: I can push the validator and template patch tomorrow EOD CET.

Michelle (Support): Plan sounds good. For immediate customer relief, support can resend a manually annotated PDF if AP will accept it. Irene, can you ask the AP team if a corrected PDF (with PO manually moved to header and VAT line added) will be accepted while we fix the flow? Also please request the exact XML/CSV field names their AP automation consumes — that will help avoid future mismatches.

Irene (Acme AP): I'll ask and relay the exact field mapping if they provide it. They said they can accept a corrected PDF for this cycle but want the automated invoices fixed for next month.

Tony (Eng): I'll take ownership. I'll: - add pre-render validator (422 + descriptive payload) - implement template fallback + explicit note when VAT missing - add unit_price inference rule and a validation flag - canary deploy to 10% traffic tomorrow morning CET, monitor 24h and roll to 100% if no regressions. Will post PR and deploy link here.

Michelle (Support): Thanks Tony. @Sam I'll add a support ticket template to collect AP mappings and attach policy language about VAT display.

Irene (Acme AP): Great, thanks everyone — I'll tell Acme AP the workaround and that the fix is coming. :thumbsup:
